The '''GD16-series pilot droid''' was a very advanced droid from MerenData.

==Characteristics==
The GD16-series came in the standard bipedal form, but it had four arms for more effective interaction with starship controls. It had telescopic arms and legs, and an extendable torso and neck to fit into any size cockpit. It had a 360 degree sensor on the crown of its head, which provided excellent vision in all directions, including straight up. It had additional forward sensors to keep track of the ship's readouts and other sensor displays. It could also pilot the ship directly through a computer link if it was installed. It cost 17,430 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new.<ref name="SGD" />

It was specifically designed for versatility and adaptability, and was able to pilot a much wider range of craft than the standard pilot droid. With the proper upgrades, it could also perform extremely aerobatic maneuvers that were almost impossible to most beings.<ref name="SGD" />
